description:
Our flagship lugged model, the Vincitore Special was introduced to the Mercian range in 1965, an era of fancy lugs where each frame builder would have their own intricately fashioned signature design. Hours are spent crafting and filing the Vincitore lugs: the result is a work-of-art, aesthetically pleasing and structurally more rigid owing to the longer lugs. A frame that is distinctive and beautiful, perfectly at home on day rides or touring holidays.

Meticulously built by our craftsmen for comfort and long-distance reliability, the Vincitore seamlessly blends classic aesthetics with modern functionality. Each frame exemplifies exceptional craftsmanship, offering riders elegance on every journey. Prepare to turn heads at the café.

Hand-made in Derby using Reynolds 725 double butted steel tubing, the bike comes with disc brakes as standard (rim brakes are also an option). Available as frame-only or fully assembled: choose one of our three assembly packages – or we can help you build up the assembly to your own specification.
